lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to finding a small task I can finish properly.
I should look around and lend a hand where I can.
There are always chores worth doing, even without being asked.
I'll go see if anyone needs help before evening.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to making today useful however I can.
I still need to bring a few things in from the yard.
There is always something nearby that needs sweeping or mending.
I'll be back once I have done someone a proper little favor.
Helping one person is still helping the village.
I'll stay busy for now and make the day count.
